summary: Website automation project for Aurora Studios: automatically fetch and update images/content from online sources and publish daily news/educational content via web scraping/search.
architectural_notes: Add an automated content ingestion pipeline (web search/scraping -> filtering -> approval/publishing) scheduled to run daily.
Implement an image sourcing strategy to auto-fetch and refresh images for Aurora Studios-related sections across the site.
imageRequirements:
## Edit Images
- Crop/resize for a wide hero/card-safe aspect ratio and export (ncert-launches-portal-for-home-delivery-of-books.jpg > ncert-sample-papers.dim_1600x900.jpg)

existing_features.title: Add a simple admin UI screen (owner/admin-only) to manage automation settings: content sources list, a "Run ingestion now" button, and a status panel showing last run time, counts, and recent errors.

Replace hardcoded site branding image usage with a backend-configurable "brand image" so the logo/brand image can be updated centrally (supporting the user’s request to update images wherever the brand name is used).

Apply a cohesive, editorial-style visual theme refresh (warm neutrals, high-contrast typography, subtle paper-like surfaces) consistently across key pages (Home, list pages, Post detail, header/footer) without changing site structure or routes.

new_feature_requests.summary: Automate fetching/updating images across the site where 'Aurora Studios' is referenced (auto-replace/refresh content images from online sources)
Daily automated web scraping/search to discover and publish new news and educational content relevant to the website

Add backend support for automated content ingestion from admin-configured online sources (e.g., RSS/Atom feeds or JSON endpoints): store a list of sources, fetch and parse new items, and convert them into queued posts using the existing ingestion/publishing pipeline.
Implement a daily automated ingestion trigger in the backend that runs the fetch+ingest job once per day, and also expose an admin-only "Run ingestion now" method for manual triggering.

Add backend support to automatically set or refresh post hero images based on admin-configured image rules: for each ingested item, derive an image URL (from the source item when available) or fall back to a category image; validate that the stored image URL is non-empty and usable by the frontend.
